name: Harrison Global Holdings Inc.
summary: Harrison Global Holdings Inc., a Tokyo, Japan-based enterprise, primarily focuses on audio content creation and the representation of voice actors. The company delivers a range of services, including comprehensive audio production and a specialized VTuber offering. This unique service enables streamers to animate virtual characters with their voice, real-time facial expressions, and gestures for live video broadcasts. Additionally, Harrison Global Holdings Inc. provides educational programs in voice acting specifically designed for Japanese youth. Established in 2017, the organization was previously known as BloomZ Inc. and is slated to officially adopt the name Harrison Global Holdings Inc. in July 2025.
